news.title: Syria's president visits Euphrates flood zones after week of deadly high water
news.description: Surging flows on the Euphrates flooded homes, farms, and schools in Deir Ezzor and Raqqa after one of the heaviest rainy seasons in three decades, with several children drowning despite official warnings. An earthen bridge collapsed, the navy deployed boats for evacuations, and Turkey agreed to reduce upstream releases. Reservoirs filled beyond 97% capacity before dam operations and seasonal rains pushed the river past protective embankments.
